dispositions.summary: MessageBubble's wrapper has no w-fit/inline-block, so a block-level box with only margin-left:auto and a max-width cap fills out to that cap instead of shrink-wrapping content — every short user message ("Hi", "Thanks") renders as an ~85%/max-w-prose-wide box with text hugging the left inner edge instead of a snug right-aligned bubble, contradicting the component's own story description ("the bubble constrains itself... instead of stretching edge to edge") and the issue's pixel-perfect acceptance criterion.

Lightbox sets role="dialog" aria-modal="true" but implements no focus trap, no initial focus move into the dialog, and no focus restoration to the triggering element on close — keyboard/screen-reader users can Tab out into the page behind the overlay, which aria-modal="true" claims cannot happen.

JsonViewer has no overflow-x-auto or wrapping for long primitive values or deep indentation, unlike every other content-bearing component in this diff (MathBlock, DiffBlock, Markdown, CodeBlock all wrap scrollable content), risking horizontal overflow inside ToolCallCard's argument/result bands at 390px widths.
ToolCallCard's failed-status Error band renders an empty box with no fallback text when the `error` prop is undefined.

Citation and WebSearchCard render external, LLM/search-provided hrefs without validating the URL scheme (target=_blank/rel=noreferrer mitigates tabnabbing, but a javascript:/data: URL would still render as a clickable link).

AttachmentCard reuses a single onRemove callback for both "remove" and "retry" actions, distinguished only by aria-label text, with no dedicated onRetry prop for the functionally different retry action (implementer already flagged this as a review scenario in implement-handoff.md).

Composer's "generating" state swaps the send button to a Stop icon with pulse animation while leaving it fully disabled (no onStop prop exists) — the UI visually promises interrupting generation but the control is inert (implementer already flagged this as a review scenario in implement-handoff.md).

Several new user-facing status color tokens (danger-300/success-300/accent2-400, used by ErrorMessage/ToolCallCard/JsonViewer/DiffBlock/AttachmentCard) are only defined under :root (dark) and never redefined under [data-theme="light"], risking low-contrast text in light theme — mirrors a pre-existing codebase-wide pattern, not newly introduced by this PR, but now applies to prominent new status surfaces.

CodeBlock's and DiffBlock's filename-header spans use `truncate` without the min-w-0/flex-1 (or block-level) styling their pattern needs to actually work in a flex row, so a long filename can overflow the header at narrow widths even though the code body below correctly scrolls.

The Chevron toggle icon is copy-pasted verbatim across ThinkingBlock, ToolCallCard, and JsonViewer, and a hostname()-extraction helper is duplicated verbatim between Citation and WebSearchCard — both are candidates for a shared src/lib helper/icon.

EmptyThread's "heading" prop renders as a plain

, not an

-

, so it's invisible to screen-reader heading navigation despite being described as a heading in the acceptance criteria — mirrors the pre-existing Card/CardTitle convention rather than a new regression.
